request_elapsed_scope: sum of full request wall times, including cache/input setup and release; excluding allocator instrumentation and progress reporting
peak_cuda_scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator peak allocated bytes since reset immediately before each measured request; after model load and warmup, including resident source Hugging Face and active course-model tensors; not baseline-subtracted, reserved allocator memory, driver/context memory, or physical GPU usage. Synchronization, reset and peak query are outside request clocks.
